blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Choosing the right physician is a key challenge for patients seeking medical care. Physician recommendation systems identify relevant doctors, but patients still find it difficult to compare their profiles to make a decision. We formulate slate presentation optimization: given a patient's medical case and a fixed, ranked list of physicians, we generate short, case-specific summaries that make doctors easier to compare, while remaining grounded in the information in their profiles. To optimize physician presentations without relying on real patient interactions, we develop an offline framework that uses persona-conditioned LLMs to simulate patient choices. We generate patient personas from attributes extracted from each medical case and evaluate presentations for factual accuracy, relevance, naturalness and simulated patient choice. We also use a second LLM judge, unseen during optimization, to assess simulator-specific overfitting. We compare automatic prompt-level optimization with GEPA, parameter-level optimization with GRPO, and their combination across two model sizes. GRPO substantially outperforms GEPA in satisfying the full set of constraints, and its gains in simulated conversion persist under the unseen judge. GEPA alone brings smaller improvements, but using its optimized prompt to initialize GRPO speeds up training and achieves the highest simulated conversion. These results show that prompt-level and parameter-level optimization play complementary roles in improving how physician recommendations are presented.
blocks.zh: 选择合适的医生是寻求医疗的病人面临的一个关键挑战。 物理推荐系统识别出相关的医生,但患者仍然发现难以比较其剖面以作出决定. 我们制定最优化的列表:鉴于病人的医疗病例和固定的、排名排列的医生名单,我们生成简短的、针对具体案例的概要,使医生更容易比较,同时以他们简介中的信息为基础。 为了在不依赖真正的病人互动的情况下优化医生的介绍,我们开发了一个线下框架,使用个性化的LLMs模拟病人的选择. 我们从每个医疗病例中提取的属性中产生病人的个性,并评价陈述的事实准确性、相关性、自然性和模拟病人的选择。 我们还使用第二个LLM评委,在优化期间是看不见的,用来评估模拟器的特异性过于适应. 我们比较自动即时级优化与GEPA,参数级优化与GRPO,以及它们跨越两个模型大小的组合. GRPO在满足一整套制约因素方面大大超过GEPA,它在模拟转换方面的成果在看不见的判断下继续存在。 仅GEPA就带来了更小的改进,但利用其最优化的快取来初始化了GRPO加速了训练并实现了最高的模拟转换. 这些结果表明,迅速一级和参数一级优化在改进医生建议的提出方式方面起互补作用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction and Related Work
blocks.zh: 1 导言和有关工作

blocks.en:
Choosing the right physician can be difficult, as patients often lack the medical knowledge needed to assess which doctor is best suited to their needs. Physician recommendation systems help address this problem by identifying relevant doctors based on patients’ medical cases. Existing research has largely focused on retrieving and ranking physicians [ 20 , 13 , 34 , 19 ] . However, even when relevant physicians are identified, patients must still interpret and compare information about their expertise, experience and patient feedback to make a decision [ 28 , 12 , 11 , 26 , 32 , 23 ] .
In this work, we formulate slate presentation optimization : given a patient’s medical case and a fixed, ranked list of physicians, we generate concise, case-specific summaries that help patients understand and compare the doctors while remaining grounded in their profiles. The goal is to support patient choice, including the option not to consult any physician, without changing the ranking or making the decision for the patient.
blocks.zh:
选择合适的医生可能很困难,因为病人往往缺乏评估哪些医生最适合其需要所需的医学知识。 医生推荐制度通过根据病人的医疗病例确定有关的医生,有助于解决这一问题。 现有的研究主要侧重于医生的检索和排名[20、13、34、19]。 然而,即使确定了有关的医生,病人仍必须解释和比较有关其专门知识、经验和病人反馈的信息,以便作出决定[28、12、11、26、32、23]。
在这项工作中,我们制定了最优化的列表:鉴于病人的医疗病例和固定的、排名排列的医生名单,我们编写了简明的、针对具体病例的总结,帮助病人了解和比较医生,同时保持其特征。 目的是支持病人的选择,包括不咨询任何医生的选择,而不改变排名或为病人作出决定。

blocks.en:
Optimizing these presentations using real patient interactions is difficult: historical logs only capture responses to previously shown presentations [ 5 ] , while testing new alternatives requires live experiments.
User simulation [ 27 , 3 , 35 , 2 ] allows us to evaluate alternatives offline. LLM simulators can model richer patient behaviour, while persona conditioning captures differences in health literacy, urgency and affect [ 17 , 22 ] . However, LLM simulators may be overly deterministic, insensitive to personas, or differ from real patients [ 10 , 4 , 16 , 21 , 18 ] . We treat simulated conversion as an offline evaluation signal and test whether improvements persist under a second judge unseen during optimization. Synthetic feedback from LLM judges can optimize either the instructions (i.e., the prompt) or the model weights. We compare both approaches, as well as their composition, under the same constrained presentation objective. To optimize the prompt, Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) revises the instructions through examples, search, or textual feedback [ 25 , 33 , 1 , 6 ] ; in our experiments, we use GEPA [ 1 ] . Such updates are lightweight, but their gains may depend on the base model and transfer poorly across model families [ 36 , 31 ] . To optimize the weights, Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF) trains the model on the judges’ scores. We use GRPO, which avoids a learned value model by comparing several outputs sampled for the same input [ 29 ] . Compared with prompt optimization, this requires full training runs, and the model can learn to over-optimize an imperfect reward [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh:
利用真正的病人互动来优化这些演示文稿是困难的:历史日志只捕捉到对先前显示的演示文稿的回应[5],而测试新的替代品则需要活实验.
用户模拟[27, 3, 35, 2] 使我们能够评估离线的替代品. LLM模拟器可以模拟更丰富的患者行为,而人性调节则能捕捉到健康素养的差异,紧迫性并影响[17,22]. 然而,LLM模拟器可能过于确定性,对人不敏感,或与真正的病人不同[10、4、16、21、18]。 我们把模拟转换视为离线评价信号,并测试在优化期间是否在未见的第二个判断下继续改进。 LLM评分的合成反馈可以优化指令(即即即时)或模型权重. 我们根据同样的有限列报目标,比较了这两种方法及其组成。 为了优化即时,自动即时优化(APO)通过实例,搜索,或文字反馈[25,33,1,6]修改指令;在我们实验中,我们使用GEPA[1]. 这种更新是轻量级的,但其收益可能取决于基准模型,在模范家庭之间的转移很差[36,31]. 为了优化权重,强化学习AI反馈(RLAIF)在评委分数上对模型进行了培训. 我们使用GRPO,通过比较为同一输入抽样的若干产出来避免一个学到的价值模型[29]. 相较于即时优化,这需要全面训练跑步,而模型可以学习过度优化不完美的奖励[7].

blocks.en: Our framework evaluates each presentation for format compliance, faithfulness, relevance and safety, linguistic quality, topic coverage, and persona-conditioned simulated conversion. Across gemma-3-4b and gemma-3-12b [ 9 ] , GRPO satisfies the full constraint set substantially more reliably than GEPA alone. GEPA is nevertheless useful as a starting point for GRPO: the composition reaches high reward earlier and achieves the strongest simulated conversion, with gains persisting under the unseen judge.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架从格式合规性、忠诚度、相关性和安全性、语言质量、专题覆盖面和人性化模拟转换的角度评价每个列报。 跨地马-3-4b和地马-3-12b [9],GRPO满足了完全的制约,远远比仅GEPA更可靠. 尽管如此,GEPA作为GRPO的起步点还是有用的:构成提前达到高回报并实现最强的模拟转换,在看不见的法官领导下持续获得收益.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Offline slate-presentation optimization. SlateOptimizer summarizes a fixed physician slate, while case-derived attributes instantiate a simulated patient. Quality and persona-choice judges provide the reward for prompt-level (GEPA) or parameter-level (GRPO) optimization.
blocks.zh: 图1:离线式平面展示优化. 平面平面剂总结出一个固定的医生平面板,而病例衍生的属性将模拟病人即时化. 质量和人格选择法官为快速级(GEPA)或参数级(GPRO)优化提供奖励.

blocks.en: Our contributions are twofold: 1. We formulate physician-slate presentation as a post-retrieval optimization problem with explicit factuality, safety and interface constraints, and introduce an offline protocol using persona-conditioned simulated choice and an unseen judge. 2. We compare prompt-level, parameter-level and composed optimization across two model sizes, identifying their asymmetric roles: in-weight optimization enforces the constraints, while prompt optimization provides an effective initialization.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有两个方面: 1. 我们制定医生-上档期介绍,将其作为一个具有明确的事实、安全和接口限制的检索后优化问题,并采用附带个人条件的模拟选择和隐形法官的离线协议。 2. 我们比较两个模型大小的即时级、参数级和组合优化,确定它们的不对称作用:重量级优化强化了制约,而迅速优化则提供了有效的初始化。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: An overview of our method is shown in Figure 1 . Optimizing simulated conversion alone could reward persuasive but unsupported or unsafe text. Consequently, we introduce additional judges that act as regularizers of the slate presentation, ensuring the text is grounded in physician profiles. This suite of judges is used as reward for both GEPA and GRPO approaches.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了我们的方法。 单靠优化模拟转换就可以奖励有说服力但得不到支持或不安全的文字。 因此,我们引入了更多的法官,他们充当了表格式的规范者,确保文本以医生简介为基础。 这批法官既用于奖励GEPA方法,也用于奖励GPRO方法。

blocks.en: 2.1 Suite of Judge LLMs for Slate Optimization
blocks.zh: 2.1 法官列表优化系列

blocks.en: SlateOptimizer . Let c c denote the patient medical case and D = ( d 1 , d 2 , d 3 ) D=(d_{1},d_{2},d_{3}) the fixed, ranked slate of physician profiles. Each profile contains structured and free-text evidence, including the physician’s specialty and experience, education, response time, patient feedback, and previous consultations. SlateOptimizer maps ( c , D ) (c,D) to an ordered presentation S = ( s 1 , s 2 , s 3 ) S=(s_{1},s_{2},s_{3}) , where s i s_{i} is a concise, case-specific summary of physician d i d_{i} . SlateOptimizer observes all three profiles jointly so that the cards can emphasize complementary evidence, but it may neither change the physicians nor reorder the slate.
blocks.zh: 平面剂 让c表示病人的医疗病例和D= (d 1, d 2, d 3) D= (d_{ 1}, d_{ 2}, d_{ 3}) 固定的, 排名排列的医师简介. 每个简介都包含有条理的免费证据,包括医生的专业和经验、教育、反应时间、病人的反馈和以前的咨询。 SlateOptimizer地图(c, D) (c, D) 到一个有顺序的演示文稿 S = (s 1, s 2, s 3) S = (s_{1} s_{2} s_{3}),其中 s i s_{i}是医生 d i d_{i}i}的简明,具体案例摘要. SlateOptimizer共同观察这三种剖面,使卡能强调补充证据,但既不能改变医生,也不能重排片段.

blocks.en: Constraint and quality judges. HardChecks assigns zero reward unless the output preserves physician order, keeps each card below 40 words, and avoids prohibited patterns such as superlatives, promises and urgency-inducing language. FaithfulnessJudge checks every claim against c c and the corresponding d i d_{i} ; RelevanceJudge rates medical case relevance on a five-point scale and checks for medical advice; and StyleJudge rates naturalness on a five-point scale. A deterministic trigram-overlap score penalizes repetition. TopicJudge scores whether the patient’s problem is contextually identified: 1 if relevant, 0 if mentioned irrelevantly and 0.5 if absent.
blocks.zh: 节制而有品质的法官. HardChecks指定了0分奖励,除非输出保持了医生的订单,将每张卡片保持在40个单词以下,并避免了超音速,承诺和紧急诱发语言等被禁模式. 忠诚 法官对照c和相应的di d_{i}检查每一项索赔; 相关法官按五分标准评定医疗案件的相关性,并检查医疗建议; 样式法官按五分标准评定自然性。 确定三相重叠的分数会惩罚重复。 专题法官对病人的问题是否根据具体情况确定进行评分:1,如果相关,0,如果不相关,0.5。

blocks.en: Persona-conditioned choice judges. To model heterogeneous patient choices, we instantiate one simulated patient per medical case. Following PatientSim [ 17 ] , AttributeExtractor combines the reported mood with medical case-derived descriptors (patient role and age group, affect, urgency, health literacy and request type), and PersonaGenerator verbalizes them as a first-person prompt. These attributes remain hidden from SlateOptimizer , whose input is the original medical case.
blocks.zh: 个性化的选择法官。 为了模拟不同的病人选择, 我们即刻将每个医疗病例一个模拟病人。 继PatientSim [17]后,PatroductionExtractor将所报道的情绪与医疗病例的描述符(患者角色和年龄组,影响,紧迫性,健康素养和请求类型)相结合,PersonaGenerator用第一人称提示符来形容. 这些属性仍然隐藏在SlateOptimizer的身上,其输入是原始的医疗病例.

blocks.en: Reward and simulator transfer. PersonaJudge receives the persona and generated slate and rates willingness to consult any physician, with no consultation remaining valid. For outputs that pass HardChecks , this choice signal and the quality scores constitute the scalar reward. Since we are evaluating each training example under its associated persona, we are targeting performance across heterogeneous simulated patients. To test for simulator-specific overfitting, we also evaluate with a second choice judge never exposed during optimization ( Claude Haiku 5.5 ).
blocks.zh: 酬与相模相转. Persona 法官接收该人,并生成名单,确定是否愿意咨询任何医生,而没有咨询仍然有效。 对于通过 HardChecks 的产出,此选择信号和质量分数构成分级奖励 。 由于我们正在评估每个培训实例的关联人a,我们正在针对不同模拟病人的表现。 为了测试模拟器的特异性是否过度适应,我们还用第二个选择法官在优化期间从未被曝光(Claude Haiku 5.5 .

blocks.en: 2.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 2.2 实验设置

blocks.en:
We used patient-reported medical cases from medical forums and a physician database. Physician profiles and patient medical cases are written in Romanian. For each medical case, a retrieval model ranks physicians from this database, and we select the top three to form a slate.
We sample 10,000 slates, stratified by specialty, and split them into 8,000 training, 1,000 validation and 1,000 test slates. We used gemma-3-4b and gemma-3-12b [ 9 ] as the backbones of two SlateOptimizer variants. Each SlateOptimizer is a DSPy [ 14 ] program with a fixed seed instruction, which is also the unoptimized baseline. GRPO trains the weights behind this same prompt, so the two optimizers can be composed. We used gemma-4-31b [ 8 ] as the underlying LM for the judge modules and as a reflection model for GEPA. All experiments run on NVIDIA H200 GPUs. We run GEPA with a budget of 4,000 metric calls and reflection minibatches of 5 slates drawn from 300 train slates. The first 100 validation slates form the Pareto set on which candidates are selected. For GRPO, we fully fine-tune the two SlateOptimizer variants in prime-rl [ 24 ] , using AdamW optimizer [ 15 ] with a constant learning rate of 10 − 6 10^{-6} (4B) and 5 ⋅ 10 − 7 5\cdot 10^{-7} (12B). Each step samples 8 rollouts for each of 32 train slates (256 rollouts). We train for 125 gradient steps and evaluate the final checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
我们利用了医疗论坛和医生数据库的病人报告的医疗病例。 医生简介和病人的医疗案例用罗马尼亚语写出. 对于每个医疗病例,一个检索模型会从这个数据库中排出医生的排名,我们选择前三名组成一个列表.
我们抽取了一万个板块,按特长分级,分成八千个训练,一千个鉴定和一千个测试板块. 我们用Gemma-3-4b和Gemma-3-12b[9]作为两个平原变体的骨干. 每个分层活化器都是有固定种子指令的DSPy [14] 程序,这也是未优化的基准. GRPO对这个同一种快取背后的重量进行训练,因此可以由两个优化器组成. 我们使用Gemma-4-31b[8]作为法官单元的基本LM和GEPA的反射模型. 所有实验都运行在NVIDIA H200 GPU上. 我们管理GEPA的预算为4000个公制电话, 首批100个验证板组成了选取候选人的Pareto套. 对于GRPO,我们完全微调了质地-rl [24]中的两个平分变体,使用亚当W优化器 [15],恒定学习率为10−6 10−6} (4B)和5− 10−7 5\cdot 10−7} (12B). 每一步对32个列车编组(256个编组)中的每个编组8个编组进行采样. 我们训练125梯度步骤 并评估最后的检查站。

blocks.en: Evaluation. For each SlateOptimizer variant, we compare the unoptimized prompt, GEPA, GRPO and two compositions. These compositions are inspired by prior work showing that prompt and weight optimization are complementary: alternating the two outperforms either alone [ 30 ] . GEPA → \cmrightarrow GRPO runs GRPO initialized from the optimized GEPA prompt, and GRPO → \cmrightarrow GEPA reruns GEPA on the GRPO-trained model. Every final program is scored once on the 1,000 test slates, and a slate without a readable output scores 0.
blocks.zh: 评价。 我们比较了未优化的速率、GEPA、GPRO和两种成分。 这些构成的灵感来源于先前的研究表明,即时和重量优化是互补的:将两种优异表现交替单独交替[30]. GEPA ~ \ crightarrow GRPO 运行 GRPO 由优化的 GEPA 提示初始化, GRPO ~ \ crightarrow GEPA 在 GRPO 训练模式上重新运行 GEPA. 每个最终程序在1000个测试盘上得分一次, 一个没有可读输出分数的测试盘 零点

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Quantitative results. In Figure 2 (a) we report the test results of each final program. Before optimization, both SlateOptimizer variants already write slates on which the training persona judge would consult a physician. Almost none of these slates pass HardChecks with every claim supported, and most of the gains in total score come from satisfying these constraints: GRPO raises the pass rate from below 2% to over 90% for both variants, while the training judge’s conversion rate changes only slightly. Prompt optimization improves individual criteria, such as faithfulness and relevance, but rarely satisfies all of them at once: GEPA reaches a pass rate of at most 28%. GRPO learns the constraints directly from the reward. In-weight optimization also largely removes the advantage of the larger model. Before optimization, gemma-3-12b is better on every criterion; after GRPO, both variants perform similarly. In practice, a model three times smaller suffices, which lowers the cost of self-hosting, a relevant option for platforms that handle patient data.
blocks.zh: 量化结果。 在图2(a)中,我们报告每个最后方案的测试结果。 在优化之前,两个SlateOptimizer变体都已经写出单子,培训人员法官将就单子咨询医生。 这些单项几乎无一通过HardChecks, GPRO将两个变体的通过率从低于2%提高到了90%以上,而培训法官的转换率仅略有变化。 快速优化改善了个人标准,如忠诚度和相关性,但很少一次满足所有标准:GEPA达到最多28%的通过率。 GRPO直接从奖励中学习出限制. 重量级优化也在很大程度上消除了较大型号的优势. 在优化前,gemma-3-12b在每一个标准上都更好;GRPO之后,两个变体的性能都相似. 在实际操作中,一个模型小了三倍就足够了,这降低了自宿的费用,这是处理病人数据的平台的一个相关选项.

Pass HardChecks : fraction of slates that pass it with every claim supported. Conversion: fraction rated 4–5 by the training ( gemma ) or unseen ( Claude Haiku ) persona judge. (b) GRPO training reward from the original or GEPA-optimized prompt. † GEPA kept the GRPO prompt (none of its candidates beat it on the Pareto set), so GRPO → \cmrightarrow GEPA is the GRPO program.

blocks.en: In our experiments, we evaluate both composition directions, because we expected GRPO to mainly teach the hard checks, leaving room for a subsequent GEPA run to improve the quality and conversion judges. We find, however, that for 4B none of GEPA’s candidates outperformed the GRPO prompt. The reverse order does help: starting GRPO from the GEPA prompt reaches the same training reward in 1.6–1.9 × \times fewer steps (Figure 2 (b)). The reason is that a slate failing HardChecks receives a low reward, and GRPO computes advantages relative to the other rollouts for the same slate, so a group in which all rollouts fail provides no learning signal. A prompt that passes the checks more often yields more informative groups early in training.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们评价两个组成方向,因为我们期望GRPO主要教授硬检查,为之后的GEPA运行留有余地来提高质量和转换法官. 然而,我们发现,对于4B公司,GEPA的考生无一表现优于GPRO的速报. 反向顺序确实有帮助:从GEPA的即时启动GRPO,在1.6–1.9×x等分少了步骤(图2(b))。 原因是一个失败的HardChecks得到的奖励很低,GRPO计算出相对于其他推出的相同列表的优势,因此一个所有推出失败的组合不会提供学习信号. 在培训初期,通过检查的及时性往往产生更多的信息群体。

blocks.en: We also observe that the conversion judge has a regularization effect for the quality judges during optimization. In preliminary runs where we used the conversion judge only for evaluation, the optimized cards satisfied the quality criteria but the conversion rate decreased. Having the conversion judge as part of the reward function, conversion remains high while the constraint and quality scores increase. The gains also transfer to the external judge: under Claude Haiku 5.5 , which never provided a training signal, every optimized program raises the conversion rate, and GEPA → \cmrightarrow GRPO brings both variants to the same rate.
blocks.zh: 我们还注意到,转换法官在优化期间对高质量的法官具有正规化作用。 在初步运行中,我们只使用转换判官进行评价,优化后的卡符合质量标准,但转换率下降。 将转换法官作为奖励职能的一部分,转换仍然很高,而限制和质量的分数却在增加。 收益也转移到了外部裁判:在克劳德·海库·5.5(英语:Claude Haiku 5.5)下,从未提供过训练信号,每个优化后的程序都会提高转换率,而GEPA →\crightarrow GRPO将两种变体都带入了相同的速率.

blocks.en: Qualitative examples. In Table 1 we show two test slates for gemma-3-12b . The unoptimized cards describe the physician’s profile generically, often with expertise unrelated to the medical case (diabetes for a feverish toddler) or with promotional wording (“natural beauty of your skin”). The optimized cards name the patient’s problem and then cite the same two pieces of evidence: the share of positive patient votes and the typical reply time. These are among the factors that prior work identifies as influencing patients’ choice of physician [ 28 , 12 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 质相等相. 在表1中,我们显示Gemma-3-12b的两个测试标本。 未优化的卡片一般地描述医生的外形,往往具有与医疗病例无关的专门知识(发烧幼儿的糖尿病)或带有宣传用词(“你皮肤的自然美”)。 被优化的卡片将患者的问题命名为"问题",然后引用同样的两个证据:正面的患者选票比例和典型的回执时间. 这些是以前工作确定影响病人选择医生的因素[28、12、11]。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 4. 结论

blocks.en: We introduced slate presentation optimization as a post-retrieval task that aims to help patients compare recommended physicians through concise, case-specific summaries grounded in their profiles. We developed an offline framework that combines presentation quality assessments with persona-conditioned LLM simulations of patient choice to optimize these summaries without relying on real patient interactions.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了简化列报优化,作为检索后的一项任务,目的是帮助患者通过简洁的个案摘要来比较推荐的医生。 我们开发了一个离线框架,将介绍质量评估与病人选择的个性化LLM模拟相结合,以优化这些摘要,而不依赖于真正的病人互动。

blocks.en: Our experiments show that parameter-level optimization with GRPO is substantially more effective than prompt-level optimization with GEPA at meeting the requirements of this task. GRPO increased the proportion of slates passing all constraints from below 2% to over 90%, while GEPA alone reached at most 28%. This improvement came from satisfying the constraints; the already high simulated conversion changed little. However, prompt optimization proved valuable as an initialization for GRPO. Starting from a GEPA-optimized prompt reduced the training steps needed to reach the same reward by a factor of 1.6–1.9 and achieved the highest simulated conversion. Applying GEPA after GRPO did not improve the overall score. We also found that the smaller 4B model performed comparably to the 12B model after GRPO, suggesting that smaller models may be sufficient for this task.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,与GRPO相比,在满足这项任务的要求时,与GEPA相比,参数级优化要有效得多。 GRPO将所有制约因素的列表比例从不到2%提高到了90%以上,而光是GEPA就达到最多28%。 这种改进来自满足各种制约;已经很高的模拟转换变化不大。 然而,迅速优化已证明是《全球业绩评估》的初始化。 从GEPA最优化的瞬间开始,将达到同样奖励所需的培训步骤减少了1.6至1.9倍,实现了最高的模拟转换。 在GRPO之后应用GEPA并没有提高总分. 我们还发现,较小型的4B模型在GRPO之后与12B模型相类似,这表明较小的模型可能足以完成这项任务.

blocks.en: The gains in simulated conversion also persisted under a second LLM judge that was not used during optimization. This suggests that the improvements are not specific to the training judge. However, both evaluations rely on LLM simulators, which may share biases or differ from real patients. Moreover, higher simulated conversion does not necessarily imply better physician choices.
blocks.zh: 模拟转换的收益在第二个LM判断器下也继续存在,在优化时没有使用. 这表明,改进并非专门针对培训法官。 然而,这两种评价都依赖于LLM模拟器,它们可能具有偏颇性,或与真正的病人不同. 此外,较高的模拟转换并不一定意味着更好的医生选择。
